description:
We are four mathematics students from Yıldız Technical University who share one belief: questions usually left to intuition can be measured, tested and proven. Each of us brings a different strength, from software and research to mathematical methods and data analysis, and we work as one team where every idea is challenged and improved together.

Orbitrary is where that belief met space exploration: using topology and open NASA data, it reads the shape of Earth to find the Moon and Mars.
